title: Modular 'Lego' Analytical Tech Transfer Protocol (ATTP) — CEX-HPLC to CEX-UPLC
regulatory_basis: ICH Q14 Analytical Procedure Development (ATP & Established Conditions)
ICH Q2(R2) Validation of Analytical Procedures (Co-Validation Bridging)

transfer_parties.donor_laboratory: Example CDMO Client Partner R&D Lab (Boston, MA) — Agilent 1260 Infinity II Quaternary HPLC
transfer_parties.receiving_laboratory: Example Commercial QC Lab — UPLC Fleet (fictional example)

lego_modules.objective: Quantify Charge Variants (Acidic, Main, Basic %) of IgG mAb with baseline resolution Rs >= 1.5.
lego_modules.acceptance_gate: Precision %RSD <= 2.0% for Main Peak; <= 5.0% for Acidic/Basic Groups.

receiver_parameters.system: Waters Acquity H-Class Bio Quaternary UPLC

lego_modules.acceptance_gate: Main Peak retention time shift |Δt_R| <= 0.15 min relative to Donor Reference Chromatogram.

lego_modules.module_name: System Suitability & Forced Degradation Specificity Check
lego_modules.objective: Verify resolution of thermally stressed Asn-deamidated pre-peaks and Carboxypeptidase-B treated basic peaks.
lego_modules.acceptance_gate: USP Tailing Factor 0.8 - 1.5; Theoretical Plates N >= 8,000; Resolution Rs >= 1.5.

lego_modules.objective: 2 Analysts x 3 Days x 3 Independent Preparations across Reference Standard and 1 Stressed Lot.
lego_modules.acceptance_gate: 90% Confidence Interval of inter-site mean difference within ±1.5% absolute for Main Peak.
